issues: How clinicians use it in treatment planning: orthognathic surgery is introduced as a likely part of clinical treatment for extreme high-angle Class II cases and framed as something to discuss. It does not put non-medical options first, and its risks are only partly given. This is a blocking issue under the medical-procedure rule.
